##### Project general facts

A vibrant haven for urban living, Hills Park is nestled in the heart of a thriving community, bringing a world of leisure, recreation and convenience to your doorstep. Situated just footsteps from a host of retail, dining and entertainment experiences, yet connected to meticulously landscaped greens, this comprehensive neighbourhood is the perfect setting for a community-focused lifestyle. 

At Hills Park, comfort, convenience and connectivity combine in one, two and three-bedroom apartments that exude elegance. Designed with contemporary living in mind, these stylish homes are ideal for those who seek a balanced lifestyle, from leisure-loving families and activity-seeking couples, to career-driven professionals and anyone in between.

The perfect harmony of comfort, elegance and ingenuity, Hills Parks' sophisticated living spaces are the epitome of chic practicality and modernity, the ideal settings for cherished moments with family and friends.

##### Location description and benefits 

Dubai Hills Estate – the green heart of Dubai – is a first-of-its-kind destination. This masterfully planned, multi-purpose development, strategically situated between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina, flanked by Al Khail Road, the community offers easy access to the city’s most popular districts and attractions. 

A city within a city – Dubai Hills Estate comprises elegantly planned neighbourhoods of contemporary apartment buildings and villa compounds in a country-village setting. With easy access to Al Khail Road, Hills Park is just minutes away from Downtown Dubai and other business, retail and tourism hubs. 

Close proximity to planned Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro lines will allow for fast and easy access to airports and other emirates in the near future.
